name: Sakaki Seri
source:
The protagonist's childhood friend. She became a nurse to help him. She is the woman closest to the protagonist and the one that understands his pain the most. She is always cheerful and positive, but she can be a little violent towards the protagonist. But that is all intended to cheer him up, and she worries about him more than anyone else. Her feelings are obviously romantic.

[Based on the [url=http://www.oaks-soft.co.jp/princess-soft/21twoone/21chara.html]official site[/url]]
